svg.title: Card fraud platform: overview
svg.desc: Layer 1 builds the features, Feast hands them to Layer 2, which trains, serves and monitors the model.
svg.text: From core banking and the card network to a fraud decision in real time, and back to retraining
drift: retraining run with the newest labels
offline: Delta feat_* tables, point-in-time joins on Spark · online: Redis, latest value per card · registry: PostgreSQL
feature service fraud_model_v1 = 7 daily stats + 13 on-demand features: one list for training and serving
DP1 -> DP2 -> DP3 -> feast_materialize, daily · drift_monitoring, daily: a KFP run on drift · validate stages (Great Expectations)
bronze raw_* -> silver stg_* -> gold dim_* / fact_* -> feat_* · ml/ training sets (one Delta version per run) · MLflow artifacts
lineage sent by every Spark job and by Airflow · validation results as assertions
